title: Consume authenticated BG descriptor metadata through guest and native reads

Complete CLI results, no-write reuse and protected inputs are recorded in private verification-summary.json. Retain the first component harness stall caused by omitted frame-ready dispatch clearing, and the first CLI helper overstrict positive-read gate on all-released runc. Only affected helper inputs changed; completed frames/idle results are reused. Wine background D-Bus diagnostics occur with passing test exits. limitations: Opt-in bounded metadata only; linked graphics/palette/packet payloads and programs still use original ROM producers. Broader BG scene/GUI/startup/frame/RSS/archive gates, other catalogs/languages, native Windows, normal enablement and mods remain open. Type-size accounting excludes allocator overhead/process RSS. No speedup, complete-ROM extraction, instruction skip, new public archive, AndroidPort change, agent commit or push.
